# Zero 2 One Data Recovery — من الصفر إلى الواحد

> Specialised data recovery in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. We recover data from hard
> drives, SSD/NVMe, RAID arrays and servers, CCTV recorders, formatted media, and
> ransomware-encrypted systems. Diagnosis first, full confidentiality, 25+ years
> of experience. The site is bilingual: Arabic at the root (/) and English (/en/).

Contact: info@datarecovery-sa.com · +966 53 101 0903 · Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Working hours: Saturday–Thursday, 10:00–22:00 (Asia/Riyadh)

## Services (English)

- [Hard drives](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/hdd.html): Hard drive data recovery for clicking hard drive recovery and unreadable hard drive. Recover data from an external hard drive and laptop hard drive.
- [SSD & NVMe](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/ssd-nvme.html): Solid-state drive recovery and internal SSD data recovery. Expert SSD firmware failure recovery, retrieve data from formatted SSD, repair and recover SSD drive.
- [RAID & servers](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/raid-servers.html): RAID data recovery service & server data recovery services. We offer NAS server data recovery, SAN storage data recovery & enterprise server data recovery.
- [CCTV footage](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/cctv.html): CCTV data recovery & deleted security footage recovery service. Recover deleted CCTV video, surveillance camera video recovery & security DVR data retrieval.
- [After format](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/after-format.html): Deleted file recovery service to recover data after format. We perform lost partition data recovery, RAW drive data recovery & restore deleted files.
- [Ransomware](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/ransomware.html): Ransomware victim data recovery & enterprise ransomware recovery. We recover files from ransomware, decrypt infected files & offer ransomware decryption.
- [Phones](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/phones.html): Mobile data recovery expert for phone memory & smartphone file recovery. Handles dead phone data recovery & recovers deleted photos from phones.
- [Cards & flash](https://datarecovery-sa.com/en/services/memory-cards.html): SD card data recovery & USB flash drive data recovery. Micro SD card recovery service to recover corrupted SD cards & perform damaged memory card recovery.

- [فيروس الفدية](https://datarecovery-sa.com/services/ransomware.html): استرجاع الملفات المشفرة بفيروس الفدية للأفراد والشركات. تقييم فني لنوع الإصابة والنسخ الاحتياطية قبل أي خطوة. لا تدفع قبل التقييم. الرياض، السعودية.

## Notes

- Stop using the affected device immediately; every write reduces recovery odds.
- Diagnosis determines the method — the storage medium only decides the tooling.
- For ransomware cases, isolate the device from the network and keep the ransom note.
